Before posting, check SECURITY.md for sensitive reports. Do not include answers, target algorithm names, raw chats, private HISTORY files, unpublished weekly attempts, credentials, or personal details. A collapsed section does not make an issue private.

## Where it happened

- Challenge ID and version (or "website / documentation"):
- Repository commit or page URL, if known:
- AI tool and version, if relevant:
- File access: retrieved repository / downloaded files / other:
- Round state: setup / invent / test / paused / frozen / revealed:

## What went wrong

Describe the problem without revealing a solution.

## Expected behavior

Which published requirement or instruction applies?

## Reproduce it safely

Give the smallest spoiler-free steps or public operation example. If the necessary details would expose an answer or private information, say so and request a suitable route instead of posting them.

## Checks

- [ ] I removed spoilers and private information.
- [ ] I described the observed behavior without treating an AI claim as a verified fact.
